name: qdistro-netvm
_comment: Declarative source of truth for what the OpenWrt net VM may expose. install-netvm.sh refuses to `virsh define` a domain XML that carries any device or service not declared here (doc/vm-definitions.md §Runtime Policy). The host-side control-plane client is bounded by exposedServices; the per-silo egress UCI is compiled by qdistro_netvm_uci and pushed via qdistro.netvm.egress_reload.
